blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–It may be an exhibition match, but Alex Eala is expecting an intense battle against fellow rising star Janice Tjen of Indonesia in her homecoming event on December 8 at Philippine Arena. Even with her 2026 WTA season over, Eala said she still intends to bring her best against Tjen while giving Filipino fans an entertaining show.
